units.text: I organised my daily route for 11 home care clients and verified the medication dispenser at every visit; over 6 months, I missed no visits.
I trained 14 colleagues to document visits in a mobile tablet app during the visit and reviewed their entries weekly; late entries dropped from 40% to 10%.
I led a weekly 15-minute meeting where both units aligned their care plans and shared staff, and I tracked open shifts in a shared Excel sheet.
